entities.summary: Adémar de Chabannes was a French/Frankish monk, active as a composer, scribe, historian, poet, grammarian and literary forger. He was associated with the Abbey of Saint Martial, Limoges, where he was a central figure in the Saint Martial school, an important center of medieval music. Much of his career was spent copying and transcribing earlier accounts of Frankish history; his major work was the Chronicon Aquitanicum et Francicum. Adémar de Chabannes was a composers & musicians from Saint-Sylvestre (988 CE, Saint-Sylvestre–1034). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
